WHERE_IT_DEPARTS_AND_WHY_MEASURED_NOT_AS.statement: The residual deficit from p = 1 is NOT a failure of the adiabatic law. It is the measured growth of the transferred CHARGE with T.
WHERE_IT_DEPARTS_AND_WHY_MEASURED_NOT_AS.evidence: A resonant half-cycle moving charge Q in time T through series R dissipates E = pi^2*R*Q^2/(8T) exactly. Inverting the MEASURED E*T product for R over the functional band gives R = 138.78-145.36 ohm, mean 142.23, spread 4.63% over a 24.3x T range -- a CONSTANT, and it sits inside the independently MEASURED TG DC Ron band 100.7-311.6 ohm (mean 190.2) plus RS = 10 ohm.
WHERE_IT_DEPARTS_AND_WHY_MEASURED_NOT_AS.the_closure: Q grows 30.723 -> 35.012 fC (+13.96%) across the functional band as the slower hop completes more of the transfer. Dividing the measured Q^2 out: E_xfer/Q^2 vs T gives p = -0.9904, R2 = 0.999802. The 1/T law is exact to 1%; the apparent 0.909 is the charge growth.
WHERE_IT_DEPARTS_AND_WHY_MEASURED_NOT_AS.fast_side_breakdown: below T ~ 50 ps the transfer stops completing (Q collapses to 14.48 fC at T = 15.93 ps, R_implied blows up to 396 ohm) and the rows fail C2/C3. Those rows are reported and EXCLUDED from every headline.

THE_ANSWER_TO_THE_BRIEFS_QUESTION.does_slowing_down_alone_save_energy_at_c: YES, and the amount is 1.26x. Measured, end to end, over the entire 24.3x functional T range: total hop energy 9.273 -> 7.357 fJ, and E_CMOS/E_QAL 3.074x -> 3.857x (level i) / 1.262x -> 1.341x (level iii, the complete ledger).
THE_ANSWER_TO_THE_BRIEFS_QUESTION.why_so_little: because the resistive transfer term the 1/T law governs is already a minority of the hop's energy at the FASTEST T the hop can work at (37.7% of the switch gate drive alone, 16.5% of the hop total), and it is the ONLY term that obeys 1/T.

cells_burn the cells own settle.note: -0.4768 normalised by VBEND^2. This IS the gate-adiabatic term and it DOES fall -- but at less than half the exponent the crossover map assumes

E_gate switch drive.note: PER-OP by construction; no power law

THE_ANSWER_TO_THE_BRIEFS_QUESTION.NEW_FINDING_the_maps_CENTRAL_TERM_measur: The crossover map's whole energy leg rests on the gate settling adiabatically, i.e. its energy falling as RC_g/T (exponent -1). MEASURED on this cell over the functional band, the cells' own settle energy falls as T^-0.389 (R2 0.954), or T^-0.477 normalised by VBEND^2 -- LESS THAN HALF the exponent the map assumes. The reason is measurable and measured: RC_g at the QAL-DELIVERED rail is 74-147 ps, comparable to T itself over most of the band, so the T >> RC_g condition the RC/T law requires is not met until T is well past 150 ps. The map applies an asymptotic law inside the regime where it does not hold.
THE_ANSWER_TO_THE_BRIEFS_QUESTION.so_the_DVFS_question: On this harness the 1/T knob at FIXED voltage converts a speed headroom into at most a 1.26x energy gain. It cannot pay for a 1.27x speed gain twice over, and it cannot move QAL across any of the driver-ladder rungs. If the campaign wants an efficiency win from slowing down, the lever is the DRIVER (up to 4.8x across the ladder) or the VOLTAGE, not the transfer time.
THE_ANSWER_TO_THE_BRIEFS_QUESTION.what_this_does_NOT_settle: the voltage half of DVFS. This track held dV fixed at 1.0 by design. The V^2 lever is untouched here and is bounded below by the Vt cliff the brief names (settling 100% at dV=1.0, 77.1% at 0.8, 34.8% at 0.6).

THE_THREE_LIMITS_THIS_TRACK_CAN_SPEAK_TO.1_the_per_op_floor: MEASURED AND BINDING. T_floor = 26.61 ps (harness ideal-PWL) / 46.35 ps (committed resonant pair), both BELOW the 105.70 ps where the hop first works. At the complete 23.213 fJ ledger there is no T in the envelope where the transfer term dominates.
THE_THREE_LIMITS_THIS_TRACK_CAN_SPEAK_TO.2_the_Vt_cliff: NOT TESTED HERE -- this track is fixed-voltage by design. Quoted from the campaign, not re-measured. But one relevant NEW measurement: the cell's RC_g at the QAL-DELIVERED 0.6754 V rail is 146.7 ps, 7.3x its 20.0 ps value at the 1.2 V CMOS rail, and the FALL edge is the slow one there (146.7 vs 74.1 ps) while at 1.2 V the RISE is (20.0 vs 10.6). The limiting edge SWAPS with the rail. Any voltage-scaling argument must carry that.
THE_THREE_LIMITS_THIS_TRACK_CAN_SPEAK_TO.3_the_hop_is_invariant_to_V_and_Vt: CORROBORATED ON THE T AXIS. t_hop over a 200x RS sweep varies by 0.0598 ps -- the hop time is set by pi*sqrt(LC) and nothing in the switch moves it. That is the same invariance the brief names, measured on a different axis.

SPEED_CONTEXT_supplied_for_the_compositi.fastest_FUNCTIONAL_QAL_level_in_this_swe: 176.9 ps (t_level, at L = 45 nH / t_hop 105.70 ps)
SPEED_CONTEXT_supplied_for_the_compositi.so: on THIS harness, at dV = 1.0 and CA = 35.979 fF, there is NO functional QAL operating point at or below the CMOS level time -- the fastest functional level is 1.88x SLOWER. An iso-performance energy ratio therefore cannot be formed from Track B alone; it needs whatever Track A's reservoir does to the delivered rail and hence to t_settle.
SPEED_CONTEXT_supplied_for_the_compositi.what_Track_B_supplies_to_that_compositio: E_QAL(T) is FLAT to within 1.26x over 105.7-2571.6 ps. So the composition may treat QAL energy as T-INDEPENDENT to 26% over the whole band, and take the operating point purely on the speed side, at whatever driver rung it can defend.

FAILURES_DEFECTS_AND_CORRECTIONS_IN_THIS.what: The first CMOS comparator decks carried a `.ic` that contradicted the t=0 input levels, holding each output against a fully-on pMOS and injecting ~186 uA of DC short-circuit current at the operating point.
FAILURES_DEFECTS_AND_CORRECTIONS_IN_THIS.how_it_showed: the 1F integrator's DC PEDESTAL became 2.235e-6 V, and at 9 printed digits that quantised the readout to a 10 fJ LSB -- larger than the whole signal. Energies came out as exact multiples of 10 fJ with periodicity readings of exactly +-100%.
FAILURES_DEFECTS_AND_CORRECTIONS_IN_THIS.caught_by: the per-row PERIODICITY guard (last cycle vs previous cycle), which is why it was in the deck.
FAILURES_DEFECTS_AND_CORRECTIONS_IN_THIS.fix: removed the .ic; DCOP finds the correct state on its own. Post-fix periodicity is 0.000% on every settled row.

FAILURES_DEFECTS_AND_CORRECTIONS_IN_THIS.what: Four CMOS rows (period 122 ps) returned nan.
FAILURES_DEFECTS_AND_CORRECTIONS_IN_THIS.cause: 1e-10 * 1e12 round-trips to 487.99999999999994 for tend = 488 ps, which fell outside every interpolation interval.
FAILURES_DEFECTS_AND_CORRECTIONS_IN_THIS.fix: clamp the requested time into [ts[0], ts[-1]].

FAILURES_DEFECTS_AND_CORRECTIONS_IN_THIS.what: STALE-ROW CONTAMINATION, and the guard caught it.
FAILURES_DEFECTS_AND_CORRECTIONS_IN_THIS.how_it_happened: the cleanup that was supposed to delete the buggy pre-fix decks ran in a compound command that began with `pkill -f "tb.py cmos"`. The pkill SELF-MATCHED and killed its own shell (the documented qal/pkill_selfmatch_trap), so the `rm` never executed. Twelve pre-fix rows then survived and were silently re-served as CACHE HITS on the relaunch.
FAILURES_DEFECTS_AND_CORRECTIONS_IN_THIS.caught_by: the periodicity/nan guard again, on the re-read.
FAILURES_DEFECTS_AND_CORRECTIONS_IN_THIS.fix: all 12 quarantined to tsweep/stale_prefix/ (not deleted -- they are the evidence) and re-run from scratch. NO stale row is in any number reported here; every CMOS row used was written after 09:10.
FAILURES_DEFECTS_AND_CORRECTIONS_IN_THIS.lesson: a result cache plus a failed cleanup is a silent-wrong-answer machine. The guard has to be on the VALUE, not on the cache key.

FAILURES_DEFECTS_AND_CORRECTIONS_IN_THIS.what: PRE-REGISTERED prediction E2 was wrong in magnitude (I said T_floor 40-70 ps at level (i); measured 26.61 ps) and E3 was wrong in kind (I predicted a crossover tau >= 12 at level (i); there is no crossover at all there).

BIASES_AND_WHAT_IS_NOT_COSTED: sg13lv_compat.sp zeroes ad/as/pd/ps: junction capacitance is ABSENT on BOTH sides. Both the QAL hop and the CMOS comparator are cheaper than reality; the RATIO is less biased than either absolute number, but neither is a silicon number.

The harness's gt/gtp/park drives are IDEAL PWL sources through series R. The MEASURED E_gate_drive (3.27-4.06 fJ) is therefore a LOWER BOUND on the real per-op switch cost, and the whole driver ladder above it is the honest range. Every ratio is reported at every rung.

The rails in this harness are IDEAL SOURCES. Slowing down does not make an ideal source more expensive. In a real design a longer T holds the rails up longer and costs static power; that term is UNCOSTED here and every slow row is therefore an OPTIMISTIC bound for QAL.

ALL NUMBERS ARE SHALLOW-STACK, single hop, 8 inverter cells. The ALU dominant cell sg13g2_o21ai_1 never settles at any operating point in the PDK envelope. Nothing here generalises to it, and nothing here is a chain result.

The 2.974 fJ resonant-pair rung is itself the arithmetic netting of two electrically unconnected ideal sources (qal/park IS3). It is quoted because the campaign committed it, and flagged because the campaign also flagged it.

The asymptote fit (E_hop -> 6.68 fJ as T -> inf, from the 4 slowest functional rows) is an EXTRAPOLATION, not a measurement. It says the complete-ledger iso-voltage ratio tends to 0.991 -- technically below 1, but only at T ~ 14.4 ns (tau ~ 720), a 5700x slowdown from the CMOS level time for a 0.9% energy win. Treat it as a bound, not a result.
